Generic price: $40 per person per year in 120 licensed countries
Brand Yeztugo US list price: $28,218 a year
First generic supplies expected in countries by end-2026
Other licensed makers' generics not yet FDA-approved

timeline.text: It could help a lot. The shot nearly stopped infections in trials, and a cheap Indian-made copy adds supply. But money, testing and country approvals still decide how many people get it.

watch.what: First generic lenacapavir supplies expected to reach countries by end-2026

threads.title: RBI reopens urban cooperative bank licences after a 22-year freeze
threads.summary: RBI froze urban cooperative bank licensing in 2004 after many newly licensed banks failed. It issued a discussion paper on 13 January 2026 and draft on-tap guidelines on 5 August 2026, with comments until 5 September. On 3 November 2026 The Hindu reported that licensing has reopened and that MSCARO and ICAI are building audit guardrails. Only existing credit societies with ₹300 crore capital can convert. Ex-NAFCUB chief D. Krishna proposes tiered capital of ₹25–100 crore.

last_state.fact: UCB licensing frozen since 2004
Draft on-tap UCB licensing guidelines released 5 August 2026; comments closed 5 September 2026
Minimum capital to apply: ₹300 crore (January 2026 discussion paper)
Only existing cooperative credit societies can convert into UCBs
UCBs numbered 1,457 in March 2025
RBI Governor: Sanjay Malhotra

timeline.text: RBI stopped giving out urban cooperative bank licences in 2004 after many new ones failed. The sector is healthier now. RBI is reopening the door, but only for large, clean credit societies.

watch.what: Public comments on RBI's draft on-tap UCB licensing guidelines closed
